events.text: At the 3rd Floor Multi-Purpose Hall, presented by Come and See. Free admission but registration is required and seating is limited, so register early via the QR code.

events.text: For 16 to 19 year olds, 3pm to 5.15pm at the Training & Development Centre, Catholic Junior College, 129 Whitley Road. Bubble tea and snacks provided; sign up at go.gov.sg/cjctot2026 by Friday 13 November.

events.text: 10am to 1pm at 55 Waterloo St, Catholic Centre #08-01, for students graduating from Sec 4 and 5. Free; register at tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov.

events.title: Advent Retreat for LGBTQ
events.text: "The Lord is Near: Come Home to Him who Comes" — a stay-in weekend retreat from Friday 4 Dec, 7pm, to Sunday 6 Dec, 4pm, with Friar John Paul Tan OFM, Sr Monika (Verbum Dei) and other clergy and religious. Register at tinyurl.com/couragedadvent2026.

events.title: SCDF Responder Plus Programme
events.text: 09:00–12:30 Church of St Stephen; free first aid, CPR-AED and basic firefighting training. Register by 1 October at office,6747 1433 or css.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.

events.title: BREATHE Youth Retreat
events.text: A stay-in retreat for 16 to 30 year olds from 16 to 20 December, organised by the Catholic Spirituality Centre. Register at bit.ly/breathe4 by 30 November.

getting_there.text: Mattar MRT DT25 ExitB, ~6-minute/450m walk via Mattar Road/Sallim Road, back gate beside The Antares. Bus 62/64/100 at Canossa Catholic Primary, Aljunied Road 70029, ~7 minutes to front gate;40/61/63/65/135/154/155/158 opposite Mattar ExitB70231, ~6 minutes to back gate.
Limited church parking. During events/carpark closure use 52A Pipit Road multistorey carpark,360m away.

ministries.name: Paradisum Wake Prayer Ministry
ministries.text: Evening prayers in church prayer rooms, funeral parlours or HDB void decks; members respond at short notice. Transport from church provided when needed. Membership enquiry form linked.

ministries.name: Music Ministry
ministries.text: The Rock Saturday 17:30, Cantores Fidei Sunday 09:00, Jubilate Sunday 11:00, plus Sunday 17:30 choir. Join via ministry contact form.
